Seen • Just now
No worries at all — getting started with Nurosym is pretty simple 👍
Here’s the easiest way to begin:
Put a tiny bit of moisture on the tragus (the small bump on your ear)
Clip the earpiece onto your left ear, with the cable going over and behind your ear
Turn the device on
Slowly increase the intensity until you feel a light, pleasant tingling
Keep it on for about 15–60 minutes per session while you go about your day
You can use it while reading, working, meditating, or relaxing — it’s designed to fit into normal daily activities
A good routine is:
30–60 minutes per day
Morning, or split between morning and evening
Tip: start with lower intensity and shorter sessions, then gradually build up so it always feels comfortable
If you have any specific health conditions or are taking prescription medications, it’s a good idea to speak with our clinical team before getting started.
